meta_description: BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, private beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.
description_expanded: Description Description BEACH ACCESS UPDATE: Due to Hurricane Isaias, private beach access for this property is temporarily unavailable. Nearby public beach access points remain available for guests to enjoy during their stay. We appreciate your understanding as our community continues to recover.30A ESCAPES presents… “Saltwater Therapy on 30A,” a serene coastal retreat tucked away in Seacrest West. This 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom home offers plenty of space for families and groups of up to 14 guests. Spend sunny afternoons by the private pool, enjoy beautiful Gulf views from the third-floor balcony or gather around the backyard fire pit in the evening. With 6 bikes included and Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and The Big Chill nearby, you'll have plenty of ways to enjoy your time along Scenic Highway 30A. Learn more below...👇*** HIGHLIGHTS ***Spacious Accommodations: 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, comfortably sleeping up to 14 guestsPrivate Seasonally Heated Pool: Enjoy your own private pool surrounded by lush landscaping. Pool heating is available September 1 through April 30.Poolside Lounge & Fire Pit: Fully fenced backyard with sun loungers, an outdoor shower and comfortable fire pit seatingUpper-Level Gulf Views: Enjoy coastal breezes, beautiful sunsets and partial Gulf views from the third-floor balconyMultiple Outdoor Living Spaces: Relax on the private balconies, patios and furnished wraparound deck6 Bikes Included: Explore Scenic Highway 30A and nearby favorites like Alys Beach, Rosemary Beach and The Big Chill*** LIVING AREA ***The second-floor living room offers a comfortable coastal setting with plenty of space to gather and unwind. Natural light fills the open-concept living area through the balcony doors, creating a bright and inviting space to relax with family and friends.Oversized sectional sofa and large flat-screen TVAccess to the wrap-around balcony with lounge seating and Gulf breezesOpen-concept layout connecting the living room, kitchen and dining area*** KITCHEN & DINING ***Whether you're preparing a family dinner or enjoying a quick breakfast before heading out to explore 30A, the fully equipped kitchen has everything you need. Stainless steel appliances, generous counter space and bar seating make cooking and spending time together easy.Stainless steel appliances including oven, microwave, refrigerator and dishwasherBreakfast bar with seating for 4Dining table with seating for 6Convenient access to the furnished balcony and gas grill*** OUTDOOR OASIS ***Spend your days relaxing by the private pool, enjoying lunch outdoors or unwinding beneath the stars around the fire pit. With comfortable lounge seating, a fully fenced backyard and multiple outdoor spaces, Saltwater Therapy offers plenty of room to enjoy the beautiful Florida weather.Private, seasonally heated poolPoolside loungers for relaxing in the sunOutdoor fire pit with comfortable seatingGas grill and outdoor showerFully fenced backyard with plenty of space for gathering and entertaining*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor:Primary King Suite: King bed, flat-screen TV, private patio access and En-Suite with dual vanities, oversized soaking tub and walk-in showerQueen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV and En-Suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo2nd Floor:Queen Guest Suite: Queen bed, flat-screen TV, balcony access and En-Suite with single vanity and walk-in shower3rd Floor:Family Suite: Queen bed, 2 Twin-over-Full bunk beds, flat-screen TV, game/dining table with seating for 6, balcony access with peek-a-boo Gulf views and En-Suite with single vanity and shower/tub combo*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Located in Seacrest West, “Saltwater Therapy on 30A” offers a peaceful setting with convenient access to some of Scenic Highway 30A's most popular communities. Take advantage of the 6 provided bikes to explore nearby shops, restaurants and local attractions.Alys Beach: Beautiful white architecture, boutique shopping and local restaurantsRosemary Beach: Charming streets, upscale dining, coffee shops and boutiquesThe Big Chill: A lively gathering spot with live music, casual dining and family-friendly entertainment*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe do NOT accept wire transfers for paymentPool heating is available seasonally from September 1 through April 30.Waiver required to get access to the 6 provided bikes. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A EscapesLSVs are not allowed in Seacrest Beach, Rosemary Beach, or Alys Beach*** YOUR STAY – OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we are committed to delivering a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and a professionally maintained home designed for connection, relaxation, and unforgettable beachside memories.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 73160STRO #: STR-073160 Read less
